message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "false_data", "why": "First-year net income is shown as 96,995 twice, but 123,485 less the 29,749 tax provision equals 93,736, and the stated EPS (6.11 x 15.34M shares ≈ 93.7M) confirms 96,995 is an inserted/duplicated figure that contradicts the rest of the table."}
message.reasoning_content:
The figures: income before taxes 123,485; provision 29,749; net income should be 93,736, but shows 96,995. Also net income column shows 96,995 twice ($ 96,995 $ 96,995) — that's a duplicate. Actually 123,485 - 29,749 = 93,736 ≠ 96,995. So false_data: figures don't tie. Also EPS: 96,995/15,343,783 = 6.32, not 6.11. Hmm 6.11*15,343,783 = 93,750 ≈ 93,736. So EPS matches 93,736 net income, not 96,995. So net income is inconsistent — a restatement/edited figure. Flag false_data.

Second column: 113,736 - 16,741 = 96,995. So the 96,995 in column 2 is correct, and column 1's net income appears copied wrongly — the "96,995 | $ 96,995" duplication indicates an editing error / injected figure. Arithmetic doesn't hold for column 1. Flag.
